method: 4 paired rounds AB/BA/AB/BA; 2 team mixes x 2 manifest states x workers 1/2/5/10; fixed gate before measurement; standalone PostgreSQL only; stages include profiling overhead
feature_cache: Full-history parity once per workload/target/immutable manifest root; all 576 manifests read/verified; paired roots must match

decision.policy: all integrity/success; no cell median/p95 regression exceeding both 5% and 10ms; >=12/16 server median-and-p95 wins; pooled server median and p95 >=5% better
